summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of EXPLORE MARS (desktop 1920x1080, mobile 390x760 with touch emulation) plus a check that the original story still works. Working: unlock gating, loading and game screens, first-run B.O.B. dialog, WASD movement and the in-game clock, mission 1 -> MISSION 2/15 Gearing Up (+100 credits), NPC panels for Queen, Goran and Andreea with accept-q1 and its toast, the Quest Log story and side tabs (30 rows, statuses shown), and the craft panel (8 recipes) with its Upgrades tab (7 upgrades). Also working: the Rover Garage opens the upgrades panel, the market sell/buy tabs, buy-o2_canister once credits are high enough (160 -> 97), the build panel (7 buildings), habitat wall/floor swatches and the sleep-btn day guard, and the map (fog, waypoint toast, clear-waypoint-btn, surface/underground tabs). Bag use-o2_canister, the trophies panel (25 achievements), all hud buttons, Esc closing panels, the game pausing while a panel is open, menu save with toast, and menu exit to title with position, story and credits restored also work. Mobile joystick movement and mars-action-btn work. The original start-game-btn intro dialogue works. FAILED: 'Restart Explore Mars' (menu-reset-btn, 2 taps) does NOT erase progress. Mobile and desktop: the interact prompt is off-center and clipped. Mobile: the prompt and B.O.B. toast overlap the mission tracker.

ui_bugs.issue: Restart Explore Mars does not reset progress. After the 2nd tap the page reloads, but the save is re-written: still MISSION 2/15 with 160 credits. Cause: deleteSave() is followed by window.location.reload(), and MarsGame's beforeunload handler (and the unmount cleanup save()) calls saveGame(G.current), which re-creates 'explore-mars-save-v1'. Fix: set a flag (e.g. G.tmp.noSave=true, or a module-level 'resetting' flag checked in saveGame) before deleteSave, or remove the listeners before reloading.

The prompt is not centered. It starts at the screen center and extends to the right. On mobile 390px it overflows off-screen ('Talk to Queen Gratzie...' is clipped; measured box x=194..430). With touch emulation this overflow also makes the page scroll sideways, so modals render at x=-27. Cause: 'animation: float' keyframes set transform (translateY/rotate), which overrides 'transform: translateX(-50%)'. Fix: center without transform (left:0;right:0;margin:0 auto;width:fit-content), or put the float animation on an inner wrapper.

integration_issues.flow: Market buy with too few credits
integration_issues.issue: At the start, credits are 60 and the Oxygen Canister costs 63 cr, so the buy fails silently (only sfx.fail, no toast or message). Add a 'Not enough credits' toast. The same applies to craft/build/upgrade failures.
use-o2_canister (and other supplies) can be used when oxygen is already full (100/100), wasting the item with no feedback. Consider blocking it or showing a toast.

issues: Under 640px, .mars-prompt (bottom:160px) and .mars-bob (bottom:160px) overlap .mars-tracker (bottom:120px, ~84px tall). Measured: prompt y=538-592 vs tracker y=555-640.

Walking up from spawn reaches the Colony Hub before the Queen (the hub sits between spawn and the Queen), so mission 1 'walk up and press E' first opens the build panel. Consider placing the Queen beside the hub or showing her as the preferred target for the talk objective.

action_items: HIGH: Fix menu-reset-btn so it really erases the save. Stop the beforeunload/unmount saveGame from re-writing after deleteSave().
MEDIUM: Fix .mars-prompt centering. The float animation overrides translateX(-50%), so the prompt overflows off-screen on mobile.
MEDIUM: On mobile (<640px), move the prompt and B.O.B. toast so they don't overlap the mission tracker.
LOW: Add 'Not enough credits/resources' feedback for buy, craft, build and upgrade failures. Starting credits (60) are below the O2 canister price (63).
LOW: Prevent wasting consumables when the stat is already full.
critical_code_review_comments: saveGame is called from several places (interval, visibilitychange, beforeunload, unmount, exit). Any 'reset' path needs a guard flag.

MarsGame keyboard useEffect has no dependency array, so window listeners are re-bound on every render (~7 times per second due to the HUD tick). It works, but it is wasteful. Use refs and an empty dependency array.
HUD tick setState every 150ms re-renders the whole MarsGame tree (Hud, Controls, panels). Acceptable, but memoize the panels.
seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage in the test browser was used (explore-mars-unlocked, explore-mars-save-v1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation helper: dispatch a document 'visibilitychange' event to force saveGame, then read JSON localStorage 'explore-mars-save-v1'.p for the player position (tiles). The colony center was (90.5, 90.5) and spawn (90.5, 93.5). Move 4 tiles/s by holding WASD for dist/4 seconds. Good E spots (offsets from the colony center): queen (0,-1.6), goran (6,1.6), andreea (-2,-3.3), fabricator (-3,-0.6), market (3,-0.6), hub (0,1.6), garage (3,3), habitat (-3,3). Dialogs may chain after an NPC panel closes, so drain mars-dialog in a few passes with waits. Mobile touch: use a new context with has_touch=True and CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent on mars-joystick. The credits explore-mars-btn was only code-reviewed (Credits.jsx:70, outcome==='win'), not tested end to end.
rca of the issue: Reset bug: Panels.jsx MenuPanel onClick -> deleteSave(); window.location.reload(). Reloading fires 'beforeunload' -> MarsGame save() -> saveGame(G.current) -> localStorage.setItem('explore-mars-save-v1', ...). The save is restored on next entry. Repro: play mission 1, Menu -> Restart twice -> Explore Mars -> still MISSION 2/15 with 160 credits and no intro dialog.
